svg.title: compress-csa
svg.desc: CSA in DeepSeek-V4. Toy with m = 4: entry i pools the 8 positions of blocks i-1 and i with a per-channel softmax, and entries are emitted every 4 positions, so windows overlap. At 1M tokens a CSA layer stores 262,144 entries; an FP4 indexer picks the top 1,024 (Pro) or 512 (Flash), and attention reads those plus 128 raw window entries and a sink logit.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: ci = Σj ∈ blki-1 ∪ blki softmaxj (zj + Bj ) ⊙ xj

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: toy, m = 4 (real m = 4, Flash and Pro)
262,144 entries (N / 4) · FP4 indexer, 64 heads × 128, scores all
core read = 1,024 + 128 entries + per-head sink logit (ch 02)
entry = 512 dims, shared K = V (MQA); FP8 + BF16 RoPE dims
